class.name: DataCache
class.brief_description: Persistent data cache for verification and metadata storage used by Entitlements and Auth subsystems.

method.name: is_verified
method.description: Returns true if the provided download_key has been verified and cached.

method.name: set_verified
method.description: Set verification status for a download key with optional metadata.

method.name: get_verification_data
method.description: Return stored metadata for a verified download key.

method.name: clear_verification
method.description: Remove verification data for a specific key.
